      "status": "documented"

      "status": "documented"
    },

      "exposure": "Penal-code section 158(3) creates a same-sex-specific offence for minors (community service or counselling), an asymmetry with opposite-sex minors; no trans-specific minor rule is documented.",

      "interaction": "A guardian travelling with a gender-nonconforming minor faces an undefined risk that a minor's presentation or conduct could be read into this provision; visitor application is unstated.",

      "exposure": "Mob attacks are documented (2014 neighbourhood apprehension of two suspected lesbians; 2015 mob attack reportedly including three police officers); LGBTQI+ people face societal violence and most remain closeted for fear of targeting.",

      "interaction": "An outed trans visitor has no realistic protective response to draw on; police involvement in a mob is itself documented.",
      "status": "documented"

      "status": "documented"
